title: Panel Manufacturing
overview: We are a CPRI Certified Electrical Control Panel Manufacturer with expertise in designing and manufacturing PCC, MCC, VFD, and PLC Panels. We provide custom-built solutions including Crane Panels, LT, HT, and Hoist Motion systems.

methodology.desc: Understanding load requirements, space constraints, and application specifics.
Drafting schematics, layout drawings, and component selection for optimal performance.
In-house fabrication using high-quality CRCA and SS304 materials.
Precise component mounting and wiring per standard color codes and safety regulations.
Rigorous in-house testing including Megger testing, continuity checks, and functional logic tests.
On-site installation and integration with field devices and main power sources.

benefits: Our panels are designed for maximum safety, reliability, and ease of maintenance. The robust construction and use of high-quality components ensure a long operational lifespan even in harsh industrial environments.

faqs.a: Yes, we are a CPRI Certified Electrical Control Panel Manufacturer.
Yes, our service engineers provide comprehensive support for installation, commissioning, and on-site testing.
